description: Daily npm downloads of the Anthropic JS/TS SDK. Developer building activity on the API; includes CI and transitive installs, so it drifts relative to revenue.
Daily PyPI downloads of the anthropic Python SDK, without mirrors. pypistats keeps only ~180 days; append daily to build history.
npm downloads of Claude Code. Spikes on releases (auto-update), and part of the install base moved to the native installer, so not used in the filter.
npm downloads of the Claude Agent SDK (launched late 2025): agents built on Claude.
Ramp AI Index: Anthropic share of business token spend x total token spend (US businesses on Ramp cards). Page shows only the current and previous period; collect every week to build history.
Ramp AI Index: share of US businesses on Ramp paying Anthropic. Measures breadth (number of customers), not spend.
npm downloads of the OpenAI JS SDK: denominator for Anthropic developer share.
npm downloads of OpenAI Codex CLI: competitor to Claude Code.
PyPI downloads of the openai SDK: denominator for Anthropic developer share.
Public commits whose message contains 'Co-Authored-By: Claude' (Claude Code's default trailer). Counts are approximate; sample one day a week, slowly.
Weekly tokens of Anthropic models on OpenRouter (all apps). Tokens, not spend. History is a rolling 53 weeks: collect weekly. Wide prior (beta 1 +/- 1): new indicator, nothing tuned on targets.
Deployed inference compute (GW / chips) from partner announcements: an upper bound on servable revenue.
AWS / Google Cloud earnings remarks on Bedrock / Vertex Claude growth.
claude.ai visits and Claude app downloads: consumer subscription driver.
Weekly tokens of OpenAI models on OpenRouter: competitor context for the Anthropic series.
npm downloads of OpenCode (open-source, multi-provider coding agent): demand for agentic coding across all model vendors, not Anthropic only.
Ramp AI Index: share of US businesses on Ramp paying OpenAI (competitor context).
Share of new public GitHub repositories that mention claude, among those mentioning claude, openai or gemini (monthly). Bounded share, so it does not explode with adoption like raw counts.
